_purpose: Search evidence for optional floor models across exactly the twelve imported Pionir projects; recovered sources are separate from authored models.
scope: Twelve imported sites, ordered by newest known design/phase evidence. Dates overlap and are not a strict completion ranking.
notes: A gap means not recovered in this search, not proof that no drawing exists.
Downloaded PDFs/PNGs were opened and visually checked before describing their coverage. Archived HTML is not a recovered drawing.
Search-result snippets and sales-page floor names do not count as geometry. No plans were inferred for missing floors.
Downloaded evidence is preserved in the ignored local tmp/pionir-floor-sources directory, named by SHA-256 plus file extension. URLs and checksums are the portable record.

All recovered whole-floor drawings with a verified building registration are modeled: 67 floors across nine model owners at four sites. Single-apartment images without a verified building position remain unregistered.
